text_block_list.text: (*whistle*, *KABOOM!*)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan! Grass!
Tonight is the Summer Carnival, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hyottoko, Okame... I won't lose
to a bunch of masked folks!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You two raise your fists, shake your hips, and dance a wild Mambo, too, YES!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't go that far, though~
Graceful modesty is also a part of Japanese culture, after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it, El-chan!
Even if I don't know how far I can go.
The summer festival was far livelier than expected.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Trainer-san!
Look at that group over there wearing masks!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The grandpas and grandmas never tire!
Look at them bust out those eye-popping funky dance moves!
It was truly something that defied her age.
Wearing a mask means becoming someone else—embodying a deity to pray for a bountiful harvest and good health, I explained.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! So you're not wearing it
to hide your true identity, desu ne!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Our opponents are formidable. But we, too, are
The Umamusume—born to run and dance!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Even if it's an incarnation of God, I cannot afford to lose!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait~~!

And the Bon Odori dance festival that kicked off
continued on without end.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant* El-chan, I can't go on anymore~

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué? But Spe-chan,
everyone's so happy, you know?
They're all cheering for you, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't your fatigue just blow away? Like, if it's
to entertain everyone, you could keep dancing forever."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"No way, that's impossible~. If it was to win a race,
I could try, but..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... It's just that... I'm not really the party animal type~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Party animal...
Party people...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You have a power that is uniquely your own.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Because I can turn the cheers of others into my strength.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Is that... what this means...
(*whistle*, *KABOOM!*)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan, what's wrong?
Are you mad, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, Spe-chan!
I'm going to dance by myself.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Who is today's star?!
A child of summer, practically a local,
the one who enjoys and entertains the most!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Her name is El Condor Pasa!!
Soaring gallantly right into the middle of the dance circle!
El Condor Pasa was the only one who kept dancing on and on.
And after the festival—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what Suzuka-senpai said to me... I finally understand today.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That only El can turn
the cheers of the crowd into power.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All Umamusume are encouraged by the cheers as they run.
—To win.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, El isn't just about winning.
I run to win, and to entertain!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What does it mean to be the world's strongest!?
It means being the world's greatest entertainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"That was El's other dream,
hidden from sight, DESU."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Just like those people wearing masks...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
With everyone getting hyped up together,
uniting our wishes, wearing masks, and dancing.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Reaching for the ultimate fun that awaits beyond!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That is surely the difference between El and the other girls.
And that is—
choice_data_list: Could this be a gift from your father?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, dat is correct.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Poured into this mask... passed down to me...
are Papa's feelings.

Beneath the moonlit sky, El Condor Pasa
takes off her mask and gently places it on a rock.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I don't put on this mask
to hide who I am.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I shall don it with the resolve to become stronger than anyone and entertain everyone, yes...
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

El Condor Pasa has always been that way.
Even unconsciously, she delights her fans with lip service and over-the-top antics.

Overtaking Silence Suzuka
at that 'Takarazuka Kinen.'

The reason we could pull that off
is probably because we felt in our bones that this was the ultimate entertainment.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please don't forget.
El's... true, unmasked feelings.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Please don't forget. El's true desire
is to entertain everyone."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If only you could understand...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Onto this mask... I place the same wish.

Closing my eyes quietly, I prayed alongside her.
It was a ritual between the two of us,
aimed toward the coming autumn.
